# Vulnerable lockfile fixture

This isolated lockfile deliberately includes `idna = "=0.5.0"`, affected by
[RUSTSEC-2024-0421](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2024-0421.html).
It is never compiled, installed, or part of the product workspace.

Generated by Cargo 1.99.0 with `cargo generate-lockfile` from a temporary package
named `advisory-scan-negative-fixture`, version `0.0.0`, edition `2024`, with
that single dependency. The checksums and dependency graph come from crates.io.
The integration test requires the real pinned scanner to report that exact
advisory and package version. An unrelated nonzero exit cannot pass the test.
